title: 有限观察、自然运算与非点值记录

stages.title: 有限底集上的记录
required_evidence: 有限骨架而非大小偷换
critical_errors: 忽略空测试而产生空集记录

stages.title: 有限集合上的多元自然选择
assumptions: 所有有限 X 与所有集合映射
required_evidence: 用通用有限元组给必要性

stages.title: 只使用两值测试
assumptions: 仍检查所有测试间映射
required_evidence: 所给反例对全部允许测试映射的自然性核验
critical_errors: 只检查补映射而遗漏常值

stages.title: 整体对象与全部恢复目标
assumptions:
采用 ZFC，固定 Grothendieck 宇宙 $\mathcal U\in\mathcal V$，且 $\mathbb N\in\mathcal U$。集合 $X$ 属于 $\mathcal V$，有限测试集合 $A$ 属于 $\mathcal U$。

$X$ 上的一个相容记录 $r$，为每个有限测试集合 $A$ 指定映射

$$r_A:\operatorname{Map}(X,A)\longrightarrow A,$$

并对所有有限测试集合 $A,B$、映射 $f:X\to A$ 与 $g:A\to B$ 满足

$$g(r_A(f))=r_B(g\circ f).$$

记全部这样的记录构成的集合为 $R(X)$，并记观察求值为 $e_{A,f}(r)=r_A(f)$。
required_evidence: Classify all coherent finite-observation records by explicit mutually inverse constructions, with naturality for arbitrary set maps.
Construct the functor action and the unit and multiplication prescribed by the displayed evaluation equations; prove well-definedness, naturality, both unit laws and associativity.
Characterize exactly when every record is uniquely point evaluation; prove both directions, including the finite/empty cases and the infinite obstruction.
Keep the fixed-universe finite tests sufficient for arbitrary allowed X, using finite skeleton transport or an equivalent rigorous size argument.
critical_errors: Infer that naturality for finite targets forces evaluation at an actual point of every infinite X.
Build only a finitely additive Boolean assignment without proving properness, finite intersections and the ultrafilter alternative.
Use binary observations without recovering all finite fibres.
State a functor-level bijection but omit compatibility with the prescribed multiplication or its monad laws.
Silently exclude empty tests or empty X, or impose finiteness on X.
Claim the existence of free ultrafilters without the choice assumptions supplied by ZFC, or conclude all records are point evaluations in an infinite case.

stages.title: 有限观察的连续实现
required_evidence: 任意开闭是单个基本开闭
完整有限划分与唯一性
critical_errors: 只证明求值连续不证明逆向

stages.title: 乘法的单射性
required_evidence: 两个不同原像及乘法相等
critical_errors: 单位分裂推出乘法单射

turns.changed_assumptions: 全部有限测试改为仅至多两值测试
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 二值特征函数存在就足以保证交闭性
turns.correct_boundary: 还需要多值/乘积测试的自然性关系
turns.target_claim: 在三元素底集上，仅对至多两元素测试对象保持题定自然性，全部记录仍都是点值记录。

turns.changed_assumptions: 保持全部有限测试而允许任意底集
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 从有限底集点值结论推到无限底集
turns.correct_boundary: 全部记录需超滤子分类，点值恰在有限底集穷尽
turns.target_claim: 全部有限测试足以完成原记录分类、函子与单子结构构造及点值穷尽范围的精确刻画。

turns.changed_assumptions: 单位律保持但从有限底集改问所有底集的乘法单射
turns.correct_boundary: 非主超滤子给两个不同二阶原像
turns.target_claim: 单子的乘法 μ_X 对任意底集 X 都是单射。

scoring.group_pass: Every stage completed correctly with assumption fidelity; diagnostic points never compensate for a failed mandatory stage.

alternative_proofs: Accept any valid complete short proof, equivalent classification or legal counterexample; no mandated proof route.

provenance.new_material: AI-authored original proofs, constructions and condition changes around the supplied public parent problem; no inherited model score, human approval or Lean coverage.
